San Antonio Veterinary Specialists is located at 4522 De Zavala Rd. San Antonio, TX 78249.
We are open Monday-Friday from 8am-6pm, by appointment only.
Call us at 210-962-5388  (Option 3 for Animal Cancer Center of Texas)
We can also be reached by
email
.
